verdict.rationale: Jira is fundamentally an issue-tracking tool where creating tasks, assigning to teammates, and setting due dates is core functionality, evidenced by customizable workflows/fields and multi-team coordination docs, plus community confirmation of assignment features (with one noting a limitation on multi-assignee). missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation/screenshots of the due-date field and independent hands-on confirmation specifically of the assign+due-date flow (only inferred from general docs and community assignment discussion).
